title: What Engineered Living Concrete Is
definition: Engineered Living Concrete: concrete with bacteria that heal and grow.
description:
Engineered Living Concrete: concrete with bacteria that heal and grow. This is Future Materials at its most ambitious — bacterial mixes research, concrete logistics engineering and nutrient supply operations converging on a single goal: making concrete hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Materials will decide strength testing outcomes this century. Engineered Living Concrete is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working concrete hulls, the larger bacterial mixes vision stalls, and with it, the concrete logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Engineered Living Concrete in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Engineered Living Concrete
title: Real Research Today: Engineered Living Concrete
definition: Today's documented research behind Engineered Living Concrete.
description:
The road to Engineered Living Concrete is already being paved. Metallic glass (Liquidmetal) and bulk amorphous alloys enter consumer and aerospace parts. The Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems advances engineered living materials.

Graphene Flagship (EU) and the National Graphene Institute push 2D materials to products. Together these programs form the bacterial mixes foundation that Engineered Living Concrete will build on — the concrete logistics results, the nutrient supply methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as concrete logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

t: 2031 — First concrete hulls product ships at scale: bacterial mixes syn
title: 2031 — First concrete hulls product ships at scale: bacterial mixes syn
definition: 2031 milestone on the Engineered Living Concrete roadmap.
description:
First concrete hulls product ships at scale: bacterial mixes synthesis proven outside the lab.

What must be true first: the bacterial mixes results have to replicate outside the lab, concrete logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and nutrient supply operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed bacterial mixes demonstrations, concrete logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting nutrient supply uptime. When all three flash green, 2031 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (5 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Engineered Living Concrete
definition: Estimates Engineered Living Concrete readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Engineered Living Concrete components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a concrete hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Engineered Living Concrete Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Engineered Living Concrete operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Engineered Living Concrete installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 67502 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where bacterial mixes monitoring, concrete logistics redundancy, or nutrient supply maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Engineered Living Concrete Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Engineered Living Concrete: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Engineered Living Concrete — concrete with bacteria that heal and grow.

Phase 1 — Prove (bacterial mixes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (concrete logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (nutrient supply): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (strength testing): concrete hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and construction-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
